summary: Fast, production-grade Python library for natural language processing, with pretrained pipelines for 70+ languages.

heroCommands.command:
pip install -U pip setuptools wheel
pip install spacy

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: spaCy is a library for advanced natural language processing in Python and Cython, designed from day one for real products. It has pretrained pipelines, tokenization and training for 70+ languages, and fast neural models for tagging, parsing, named entity recognition, text classification and more.
sixtySeconds.problem: Turning raw text into structured data needs reliable, fast NLP. spaCy gives you production-ready pipelines you can also train and extend.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for speed, a polished API, pretrained models and an established ecosystem, under the MIT license.

overview: Install with pip (or conda via conda-forge), then download a trained pipeline such as en_core_web_sm with python -m spacy download.
Load a pipeline with spacy.load("en_core_web_sm") and call it on text to get a Doc with tokens, tags, entities and more.
When upgrading, run python -m spacy validate to check that installed pipelines are compatible. spaCy is MIT licensed.
limitations: Not an LLM; best for structured NLP tasks

steps.code:

firstRun.title: Process a sentence
firstRun.code:
import spacy

nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
doc = nlp("This is a sentence.")

tutorial.title: Find entities in text
tutorial.useCase: Load a pipeline and list the entities it finds.

steps.title: Load and run
steps.code:
import spacy

nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
doc = nlp("This is a sentence.")
for ent in doc.ents:
    print(ent.text, ent.label_)

tutorial.expected: Each named entity in your text with its label.
